implemented: Home, unified song/album/artist search, persistent mini-player and fixed expanded player.
Native AVPlayer, embedded resolver, queue editing/reordering, seeking, shuffle/repeat and restore without autoplay.
Local Library, likes, personal playlists/photos, history, saved albums/artists and queue saving.
Album/artist pages, discography and catalogue navigation from song metadata.
Lyrics reader with follow controls, contiguous lyric selection and song/lyric image cards.
Native Photos saving and system sharing for cards, with explicit outcomes.
Sleep timer, song radio, Autoplay and automatic-occurrence queue labels.
New-playlist-only .ritvio.json import/export, selection and duplicate handling.
English/Italian, motion settings and reviewed manual Help reports.
notYetPorted: Audio equalizer and the complete Android/Windows discovery-home catalogue are not included.
Playlist import from a public provider URL is not included; portable .ritvio.json files are supported.
There are no cloud accounts/sync, offline audio downloads or automatic IPA installation.
deferredChecks: Physical-device acceptance is intentionally deferred until after the candidate/source are uploaded to GitHub. This is a beta, not a stable iOS release.
Personal signing, installation and updating with preserved local data on an iPhone running iOS 15 or newer.
Actual provider search/stream/lyrics availability, audible playback, skip/seek and automatic continuation.
Locked-screen playback/media controls, headphones, Bluetooth, calls, Wi-Fi/mobile transitions and recovery.
Photos saving/permissions, Files/iCloud import/export, clipboard and activity-sheet completion, with uninterrupted playback.
Actual Android/Windows file interoperability, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, keyboard/safe-area behavior and iOS 15 compatibility.
Free-account signing renewal through Sideloadly. Never send Apple credentials in RITVIO or support reports.
